name: Aven Courier
oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever this creature attacks, choose a counter on a permanent you control. Put a counter of that kind on target permanent you control if it doesn't have a counter of that kind on it.
blocked_sentences: Whenever this creature attacks, choose a counter on a permanent you control. Put a counter of that kind on target permanent you control if it doesn't have a counter of that kind on it.

needs.what: an op that has the controller choose one counter kind from among the kinds currently on permanents they control, binding it (e.g. `as: "kind"`) so a later `add_counters` can take `counter: {"binding": "kind"}` and a condition/selector can test `has_counters: {"binding": "kind"}` on the target ("if it doesn't have a counter of that kind on it")
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `add_counters` takes only a fixed printed `counter` kind; `move_counters`/`remove_counters` have `any_kind` but move or remove existing counters from a source rather than naming a kind and putting a fresh one elsewhere; `proliferate` adds to every kind already present on chosen objects, not one chosen kind onto a permanent lacking it; `choose_type`/`choose_color`/`choose_card_name` choose other vocabularies, not counter kinds
